360cap-exotrail:teamtailor:c440678a-7b68.description: About Exotrail 🚀 Born from a strong ambition to reach for the stars, Exotrail is a fast-growing scale-up founded in 2017. Oversee equipment metrology tracking and calibration. Guarantee the availability, compliance status, maintenance, storage and traceability of GSE, tooling and lifting equipment used by AIT. 📌 Coordinate AIT campaign logistics, internal and off-site : Prepare and secure the physical and documentary availability of components, equipment, GSE and tooling required for AIT campaigns, environmental testing and off-site operations. Coordinate shipments and transport in interface with relevant functions: packaging, transport documentation, packing lists, logistics readiness, customs and export control requirements where applicable. 📌 Define stock policy and structure logistics processes: Define with the Industrialisation & Methods team the stock management policy, consumables, long-lead components and replenishment thresholds. Implement logistics processes adapted to ramp-up and monitor associated KPIs: kit completion rate, inventory discrepancies, means availability, logistics incidents, NCR related to storage, handling or transport. 📌 Structure the Industrial Support AIT Pole : Define processes, tools, standards and KPIs for the pole. Capture field lessons learned and continuously improve the organisation. In due course, recruit, manage and develop the Industrial Support AIT team. Preferred Experience 💁‍♀️ 📌 E

a16z-anduril-industries:greenhouse:51095.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. ABOUT THE TEAM Anduril is fielding the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of seabed exploration. Anduril has brought to the market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth platform, and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "large" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on multi-million-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations. WHAT YOU’LL DO Contribute to all stages of the vehicle product development and manufacturing life cycle and provide feedback to the engineering team Build, integrate, and test complex electro-mechanical assemblies into our world class AUVs Apply competency in use of hand tools, assembly tooling and general manufacturing equipment Complete transactions in computer production systems (MES, NetSuite, JIRA) on daily basis Provide training and support new operator training as required. Show up every day with a high level of urgency and enthusiasm to get the job done Handle multiple priorities, organize workload, and meet deadlines. The Lead R&D Technician will report to the Production Supervisor and work alongside other R&D Technicians, leading technician staff in the production and delivery various commercial & development products While executing manufacturing operations, apply a higher level of knowledge and skills in hardware assembly, troubleshooting and repair. Prioritize work activities for operators to achieve target on time delivery goals. Handle multiple priorities, organize workload, and meet deadlines. Ensure they are working on the right thing at the right time. Be an active participant in 5S and continuous improvement activities. Provide feedback on ways to improve building process. Build a positive and collaborative team culture that promotes product knowledge, skills development, and X-training REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 7+ years of electronics experience in an R&D environment. Ability to work through R&D tasks with limited oversight Experience with building and troubleshooting cables and wiring harnesses. Familiar and comfortable with soldering, crimping, assembling cables and connectors A full understanding of the product life cycle
